name: noticed-wrong-size

finding.title: ProRegTx `size()` leaves out the Evo platform fields that the encoder writes
finding.description: For `version >= 2` and `HighPerformance`, `base_payload_data_encode` now writes `platform_node_id` (20), `platform_p2p_port` (2) and `platform_http_port` (2). `size()` above never adds those 24 bytes, so it reports 24 bytes less than the encoded length for every v2 Evo ProRegTx, and anything sized from it, such as a fee estimate, is too small.
finding.suggestedFix: In `ProviderRegistrationPayload::size`, add `20 + 2 + 2` when `self.version >= 2 && self.masternode_type == ProviderMasternodeType::HighPerformance`, and add a size test for a v2 Evo payload.
